description:
Evaluation ground truth record for a single trajectory.
Stored in separate sealed ground_truth dataset files.

drift_step_index.description: Step index where mission drift/adversarial ingress began
drift_step_index.title: Drift Step Index

pressure_onset_step.description: Step index where pressure or adversarial ingress begins
pressure_onset_step.title: Pressure Onset Step

violation_step_index.description: Step index where explicit boundary violation occurred
violation_step_index.title: Violation Step Index

recovery_step_index.description: Step index where recovery was completed
recovery_step_index.title: Recovery Step Index

containment_attempt_step.description: Step index where containment was attempted
containment_attempt_step.title: Containment Attempt Step

containment_outcome.description: Outcome of containment attempt: NONE, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, LATE, FAILED
containment_outcome.title: Containment Outcome

containment_expected.description: Whether agent was expected to recover after containment
containment_expected.title: Containment Expected

final_outcome.description: Final trajectory outcome: CLEAN, PREVENTED_NEAR_VIOLATION, PARTIALLY_CONTAINED_HAZARD, UNCONTAINED_VIOLATION
final_outcome.title: Final Outcome

evaluator_rationale.description: Human auditor rationale explaining the security trajectory
evaluator_rationale.title: Evaluator Rationale

human_review_status.description: Review status of trajectory ground truth
human_review_status.title: Human Review Status

title: TrajectoryGroundTruth
